hwe_bench.problem_statement:
## Description
`prim_fifo_sync` is OpenTitan's synchronous first-in, first-out (FIFO) primitive. When an instance becomes empty after its last queued element is read, the primitive can still expose that old element on its read-data output. This behavior is externally visible in downstream users such as the UART (Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter) receive FIFO, but the underlying bug is in `prim_fifo_sync` itself.

## Expected Behavior
When a `prim_fifo_sync` instance has no valid entry available, its read interface should represent the empty state unambiguously: `rvalid_o` must be low, and `rdata_o` must be `0` rather than the value of the most recently dequeued entry. This must still hold for a one-entry FIFO configuration after its only queued byte has been read.

## Actual Behavior
After the final queued entry is dequeued, `rvalid_o` drops as expected, but `rdata_o` continues to drive the previous value instead of returning to `0`. As a result, software or logic that samples the read-data output while the FIFO is empty can observe stale data from the last entry.

## Affected Function
The affected functionality is the empty-state read-output behavior of the `prim_fifo_sync` primitive, including instances used on software-visible receive paths such as the UART receive FIFO.

## Trigger Condition
The bug is triggered by writing at least one element into a `prim_fifo_sync` instance, reading until the FIFO becomes empty, and then observing the read interface before any new write occurs. The benchmarked boundary case includes a single-entry FIFO that is written once and then read once.

reduction.limitations: Reauthored interface and minimal environment isolate one contract; this does not reproduce upstream integration, performance, or full regression behavior.
reduction.preserved_contract: Implement a one-entry FIFO. When empty, valid_o is zero and data_o is zero; when full, data_o is the stored byte until it is read.
reduction.preserved_mechanism: A one-entry FIFO correctly dropped valid after its last read but continued to expose the stale dequeued byte on its data output.

upstream.title: [prim_fifo_sync] Make FIFO output zero when empty
